issues.description: The problem statement and repository metadata use different project/branding identifiers: the problem text refers to the exercise as 'Panic at Seal Saloon' / 'Seal Saloon' (domain entity), while the provided Gradle settings use rootProject names containing 'Panic-at-Burger-House' (template) and 'Panic-at-Burger-House-Solution' (solution). This divergent naming for the same exercise context can create minor confusion for students mapping the exercise description to the repository and build artifacts.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the exercise/project name consistent across artifacts. Update the repository settings.gradle rootProject.name entries to reference 'Panic-at-Seal-Saloon' (or adjust the problem statement if the intended name is 'Burger House') so the problem description and project metadata use the same identifier.
